clips.title: The story
paras: The Caravan Road is an Alliance quest that traces the footsteps of the missing night elf priestess Velinde Starsong. Following information uncovered in Booty Bay, the trail leads north from the perilous jungles of Stranglethorn Vale into the shadowed town of Darkshire.

Tracking Velinde Starsong across the world brings adventurers from the forests of Ashenvale all the way to the southern port of Booty Bay. There, Caravaneer Ruzzgot recalls an unusual passenger: a night elf priestess traveling alongside his dusty shipping caravan. Such solitary journeys are rare for her kind, making her journey through the lawless jungle of Stranglethorn Vale stand out in the minds of merchants.

According to Ruzzgot, he and Velinde parted company on their trek northward through the jungle, with the priestess striking out toward Duskwood. Her trail points directly to the beleaguered town of Darkshire, where the town's records are meticulously maintained by Clerk Daltry. In an era troubled by supernatural threats, Daltry logs every unfamiliar traveler entering the settlement, making his ledger the next vital link in unraveling Velinde's fate.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Turns out I was wrong about you, and that isn't something that happens everyday.

It just so happens that I remember this Velinde you're looking for. Isn't every day that a night elf priestess that wants to travel with a dirty old—but great for your shipping needs!--caravan like my own.
We split up on the way north, she was headed for Darkshire. The clerk there keeps all sorts of records. Might know something useful.
Be careful in the jungle, it is a deadly place even at the best of times.

clips.title: Completion
paras: With all the strange happenings of the last few years, I keep as good records of strangers as I can. Never know when it might come in handy... Though it's usually not pleasant business when it does. Not to suggest anything about this Velinde you're looking for.
